# Fixture provenance

`upstream/` is an unmodified copy of `tests/paper/fixtures/` from paper-docx
commit `3c0f9a56c73105564a6a44661c6d058a0d3fc800` (MIT; see `/NOTICE.md`).
Every file is hash-frozen by `upstream/MANIFEST.sha256`; the
`fixture_manifest_is_intact` test (`crates/docrs/tests/kernel.rs`) fails on
any drift.

Per the sidecars: 31 files are generated by upstream's authoring
scripts, 9 are LibreOffice exports and 1 is a Google Docs export. No
Microsoft Word–authored fixture is included. 40 of 41 sidecars are marked
"UNVERIFIED — agent-authored" upstream; their ground truth has no human
sign-off.

Rust-specific synthetic fixtures for the kernel and editing tests are
generated in-test from code (see `crates/docrs/tests/support/`), never
committed as opaque binaries. The Markdown converter's reference templates
under `markdown/` are committed `.docx` files, described in
`markdown/templates/README.md` and `markdown/templates/v2/README.md`;
`markdown/html-converted-template.docx` is written by
`tools/markdown/make_html_converted_template.py`.
